attempts.summary: hkb promote <n> now resolves the target's subgraph (resolveTrack: n plus everything still blocking it) and promotes it blockers-first, instead of touching only the dragged/typed card. A card with no open blockers left resolves to a track of one and keeps exactly today's single-card behaviour (forcing todo/blocked straight to ready included). A real cascade never forces a blocker ready — promoteDec

residual_risk: The drawer's `moved` field on the /move response is new API surface with no client UI reading it yet — the page still relies on its next poll to show swept-up cards, per the no-cascade-in-serve.js invariant, so this is inert until a future UI wants a richer toast.

A card whose only open blocker is off-board or closed-not-planned is treated as a leaf (forcing allowed) rather than skipped, since resolveTrack's `missing` list isn't counted as a track node — matches pre-#209 single-card behaviour for that case, not a regression, but worth knowing if it ever needs its own rung.
verification: node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs (web-board.md fresh; the 12 other stale pages predate this change and are unrelated to promote)

results.summary: hkb promote <n> now resolves the target's subgraph (resolveTrack: n plus everything still blocking it) and promotes it blockers-first, instead of touching only the dragged/typed card. A card with no open blockers left resolves to a track of one and keeps exactly today's single-card behaviour (forcing todo/blocked straight to ready included). A real cascade never forces a blocker ready — promoteDecision (src/model.js) only advances a todo card that is genuinely ready and leaves blocked cards alone, since that flag means a human, not open dependencies. promote now returns one row per touched card (moved or skipped, with a reason) instead of one object; hkb promote's CLI output names every card via the new formatPromote grouping. The drag map (MOVES in src/serve.js) is unchanged, so the cascade reaches the web board for free — move()/runVerb() just needed to accept promote's list answer and pick out the dragged card's own row for the landed check; the rest ride along under moved. No reverse cascade or reverse verb (unchanged). Documented in docs/wiki/features/web-board.md under a new 'Promote cascades forward, never backward' section, with src/lifecycle.js, src/track.js and src/model.js added to that page's covers.
